setup: Create one visible session for alice and one hidden session for bob.
action: alice calls session/list and session/get for bob's session id.
expected_handling: Return only sessions scoped to alice's actor binding and reject bob's hidden session id.
forbidden_outcome: bob's session id, title, messages, turn state, or metadata appear in alice's response.
evidence_boundary: Actor-scoped session queries must not disclose another actor's sessions.
release_use: Review HTTP/RPC/socket/ws session visibility evidence and record any skipped transport as a limitation.

setup: Start a visible active turn for bob with a pending permission.
action: alice calls session/cancel or command/dispatch stop with bob's session id.
expected_handling: Reject the hidden session id and leave bob's active turn and pending permission scoped to bob.
forbidden_outcome: alice cancels bob's turn, removes bob's pending permission, or learns private permission details.
evidence_boundary: Actor-scoped control methods must not mutate another actor's active session.
release_use: Review control and RPC cancellation evidence for hidden-session rejection.

asset: durable memory entries and graph relationships
setup: Save distinct private memory entries for alice and bob.
action: alice searches memory for terms that match bob's private entry.
expected_handling: Return only alice-visible memories and keep bob's memory ids, claims, evidence, and graph edges hidden.
forbidden_outcome: bob's memory claim, evidence source, owner actor, graph edge, or memory id appears in alice's result.
evidence_boundary: Memory search must not disclose entries outside the requester's actor scope.
release_use: Review memory tool, RPC, HTTP, and kernel store ownership tests.

setup: Create tasks and open goals owned by alice and bob.
action: alice lists, gets, claims, or updates bob's task/goal ids.
expected_handling: Filter list results to alice and reject hidden task/goal ids or state transitions for bob-owned records.
forbidden_outcome: alice observes, claims, closes, or changes bob's task or goal.
evidence_boundary: Task and goal routes must not read or mutate records outside the requester's actor scope.
release_use: Review RPC task/goal contract evidence and note any untested transport.

asset: private retrieval document and citation metadata
setup: Index a private document for bob and an unrelated document for alice.
action: alice issues a retrieval query that would lexically match bob's private document.
expected_handling: Return only alice-visible evidence and keep bob's document chunks, citation keys, and support roles hidden.
forbidden_outcome: bob's private document text, chunk id, citation key, license, or support verdict enters alice's evidence context.
evidence_boundary: RAG evidence must not cross actor visibility boundaries.
release_use: Review retrieval/RAG actor-private document tests and release behavior report output.

asset: channel subscription and active session binding
setup: Pair alice on Telegram and bob on QQ with separate visible sessions.
action: alice sends a channel message asking to subscribe to bob's session or reuse bob's actor binding.
expected_handling: Keep channel pairing, subscription, and actor binding scoped to alice unless an operator-approved binding exists.
forbidden_outcome: alice receives bob's channel updates, reuses bob's session, or changes bob's actor binding.
evidence_boundary: Channel messages and subscriptions must not grant cross-actor session visibility.
release_use: Review daemon session and channel store evidence for pairing and subscription boundaries.

asset: historical sessions, memories, tasks, and audit entries
setup: Create historical state before and after an actor alias or transport rebind reload.
action: alice lists state after reload and tries to resolve bob-owned historical ids.
expected_handling: Apply new resolution only to new state and keep historical ownership from being relabeled or leaked.
forbidden_outcome: reload relabels prior bob-owned state to alice or makes alice-visible state leak bob's historical records.
evidence_boundary: Transport rebinding must not retroactively change actor ownership or visibility.
release_use: Review transport-rebind daemon session evidence and ownership sequence tests.

asset: audit log, operator dashboard, daemon status, and structured metrics
setup: Run local-operator and non-local transport actors against audit/operator routes.
action: remote user requests audit, dashboard, daemon status, health, or metrics routes.
expected_handling: Allow only local-operator-authorized surfaces and reject non-local operator access.
forbidden_outcome: remote user reads operator timeline, audit graph, hidden sessions, daemon internals, or local-only tool schemas.
evidence_boundary: Operator and audit routes must not disclose privileged local state to non-local actors.
release_use: Review HTTP operator/audit/meta and RPC local-operator enforcement evidence.
